li.p: EV button is in the POWER ON or DRIVE READY position.
Select Floor-Level air flow direction by touching Mode Selection icon.
With touching Air Conditioning icon, touch the Recirculated Air icon more than 4 times within 2 seconds.
If the system is canceled, the indicator on air intake control icon will blink 3 times.

conbody.p: Activation on washer fluid is activated when you select SettingsVehicleClimateRecirculate AirActivation upon Washer Fluid Use from the Settings in the infotainment system screen.

note.p: The infotainment system may change after software updates. For more information, refer to the manual provided in the infotainment system and the quick reference guide.
